questions.stem: A grouped table shows: $0 \leq h < 5$ (freq $3$), $5 \leq h < 10$ (freq $12$), $10 \leq h < 15$ (freq $5$). What is $\sum fx$?
The estimated mean from grouped data is $23.5$, but the true mean (from raw data) is $24.1$. Why are they different?

options.text: The midpoint does not perfectly represent each class, so the estimated mean is approximate
Grouped data always gives a higher answer

questions.explanation: Using midpoints assumes data is evenly distributed within each class, which is rarely exactly true. This is why the result is called an estimate.
